literal_meaning: কপালের মোচড় বা ঘুরপাক (forehead's twist or turn)
figurative_meaning_en: Malefic influence, misfortune, ill luck; bad destiny; fault of fate/misery/calamity
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কপালের ফেরে চাকরিটা হারিয়ে গেল।
এই দুর্দৈবের কপালের খোঁচায় সবাই কষ্ট পাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his ill fate, he lost the job.
Everyone is suffering because of this twist of misfortune.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural belief in fate inscribed on the forehead, influenced by astrological concepts.
